channel.title: DOX
channel.description: News and releases of Dox, the web backend framework for Dart.

item.title: Background jobs and scheduled tasks in Dox
item.author: Dox team
item.description: This post shows how to move slow work out of the request with a queue, and how to run work on a timer with the scheduler.

item.title: A full-stack app with Dox and Inertia
item.author: Dox team
item.description: This post shows how to build a React app on top of Dox with Inertia, with no separate API between them.

item.title: Dox vs Go: speed and memory
item.author: Dox team
item.description: In our published benchmark on 2 CPU cores, a Dox app handled 2× to 4.8× the requests per second of a Go app. Go used less memory once a database was added.

item.title: Build a Dart API with Dox
item.author: Dox team
item.description: This post shows how to go from an empty folder to a tested API with a database, validation and a native binary, in a few short steps.

item.title: A tour of Dox features
item.author: Dox team
item.description: This post is a short tour of the parts that come with Dox, from routing and validation to the ORM, login, queues, mail and the CLI.

item.title: Dox vs Node.js: memory and speed
item.author: Dox team
item.description: In our published benchmark on 2 CPU cores, a Dox app served more requests per second than a Node.js app and used much less memory.

item.title: Live updates with Socket.IO in Dox
item.author: Dox team
item.description: This post shows how to add live updates to a Dox app with Socket.IO. When one user changes data, the screens of the other users change too, with no refresh.

item.title: What makes Dox fast
item.author: Dox team
item.description: Dox is fast because your Dart code runs as a compiled binary, the network and database work happens in native code on the same thread, and most of the setup...

item.title: Dox 3.1 is out
item.author: Dox team
item.description: Dox 3.1 adds new routing tools, request helpers, new ORM features, access tokens, a new MCP package, mail and queue features, and many security and bug fixes.
